name: Virgin Wife, Hisoyaka na Kaitsuu ~Anata, Otou-san ni Shitsukerarete Shimatta no...~
original_name: ヴァージン・ワイフ、密やかな開通～あなた、お父さんに躾けられてしまったの…～
source:
Asaishi Sousuke had lost his wife and was struggling with living alone. Seeing the father in such a state, the son Haruhiko and his wife Kurumi offered to move in with him, but Sousuke kept refusing. He was being stubborn, but there was another reason for his refusal.

It was his daughter-in-law, Kurumi. She was incredibly attractive and had married into the family while still innocent and sheltered. Sousuke harbored dark thoughts about this pure, untouched young woman.

She was his son's wife and would never be his. But he couldn't help but want to plunge his swelling pride into Kurumi. It was an impossible desire... until fate, or perhaps a devil's temptation, presented Sousuke with an opportunity.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.torpedo-game.com/trp_002.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
浅石壮介失去了妻子，独自生活令他应接不暇。儿子阳彦和儿媳胡桃见父亲如此辛苦，主动提出搬来同住，却屡次遭到壮介拒绝。他固然有些顽固，但拒绝背后还藏着另一个原因。

那个原因正是儿媳胡桃。她美得令人难以抗拒，嫁入浅石家时又仍是个天真懵懂、不谙世事的女孩。面对这名纯洁无瑕的年轻女性，壮介心中滋生出了阴暗的念头。

她是儿子的妻子，永远不可能属于自己。可壮介还是无法遏制欲望，想把胀硬的肉棒插进胡桃体内。那本应是永远无法实现的妄想……直到命运——又或恶魔的诱惑——把一次机会送到壮介面前。

[译自[url=https://www.torpedo-game.com/trp_002.html]官方网站[/url]]
